title: Cute, but falls apart.
text: Cute, but falls apart.. Very cute gnome that's taller and fatter than I expected--and I love it. I almost missed the strings; they come separately (I thought they were already part of the gnome) and they're easy to miss. The gnome came without a shipping box and was delivered in just the product box. Thankfully it wasn't stolen. Inside was the gnome wrapped in just a clear plastic bag. I took the gnome out and tossed the box and bag. Out of the bag, the gnome (branches) were flat against the belly, so I stretched them out. Be very careful! The branches are just glued to the fabric and not very well glued; a couple came out before I realized how delicate I had to be. I couldn't find the lights, so I thought they weren't included. I almost messaged the seller until I thought to check the box again. Nothing was in the box, so I checked the bag again. The bag was weightless, but then I spotted the clear lights. They're super clear and super light, so I missed them the first time. They're easy to wrap around the gnome and take two AAA batteries (not included, mind you).
